_comment: Verified Omnibus deployments. 'omnibusAddress' is the canonical CREATE3 address derived from (CreateX, deployer EOA, salt) — predicted by `make verify-omnibus`; 'chains' lists chain ids where it is VERIFIED-deployed. While 'chains' is empty, the SDK resolves no built-in address and requires an override. The address below is the PREDICTED wallet-route Omnibus (salt entropy QUIP:Omnibus:v1.0.0-alpha.2, two-argument constructor) — not yet deployed anywhere. Add a chain id to 'chains' only after the deployment is confirmed on-chain for it.
